hero.headline: Get Back to Living Your Best Life
hero.subheadline: Personalized physical therapy and wellness care in Oshkosh, WI — where your recovery is treated with the same urgency as our own.

intro.heading: Why Fox Valley Physical Therapy?
intro.text: Since 1990, Fox Valley Physical Therapy & Wellness has been the trusted choice for rehabilitation in Winnebago County. Our 7,500 sq. ft. facility features a therapeutic pool and fully equipped gym — all designed to help you heal faster and stronger. We believe therapy is not only our profession — it's our passion.
highlights: One-on-one personalized care in a private setting
Therapeutic pool and full gym on-site
No referral required — direct access available
Voted top private practice in Winnebago County

servicePreview.heading: How We Can Help
servicePreview.subheading: Comprehensive rehabilitation services tailored to your needs

services.title: Physical Therapy
services.description: Expert treatment for injuries, post-surgical recovery, chronic pain, and more — customized to get you moving again.

services.title: Aquatic Therapy
services.description: Our on-site therapeutic pool provides low-impact rehabilitation that reduces stress on joints while building strength.

services.title: Sports Rehabilitation
services.description: Get back in the game with specialized athletic training, sports analysis, and performance conditioning.

services.title: Dry Needling
services.description: Targeted trigger point therapy to relieve pain, reduce muscle tension, and restore range of motion.

services.title: Hand Therapy
services.description: Specialized occupational therapy for hand, wrist, and upper extremity injuries including custom splinting.

services.title: Women's Health
services.description: Dedicated programs for pelvic floor rehabilitation, prenatal and postpartum care, and women's wellness.
